# Mahfozur Rahman

> Mahfozur Rahman is a Full-Stack .NET and Angular developer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, with 6+ years of experience building and supporting production software for clients in the US and Bangladesh. He started on .NET Framework, ADO.NET and T-SQL stored procedures and now builds multi-tenant SaaS with .NET 8, Angular and Microsoft Azure. He uses AI coding agents (Claude Code, Google Antigravity) every day and reviews, tests and debugs every change himself. He is a Microsoft Certified Professional (MCP).

He is open to full-stack .NET and Angular roles. To contact him, use the contact section of the portfolio or LinkedIn.

## Work
- COBAIT (Aug 2023 to present): Software Developer on BizTRAQ, a multi-tenant platform on Microsoft Azure for US businesses in healthcare, fuel distribution and case management. Built two-factor authentication, a .NET 8 Blazor document service, BizDRIVE document features, server-side record grids and an LLM-powered AI Document Chat.
- LivingHub Technologies: co-built the .NET 6 CQRS back end of a building utility-management SaaS with a small team, on PostgreSQL and EF Core, deployed with Docker and Nginx.
- Global Software Architects (Oct 2020 to Oct 2022): reporting back end of the AutoGuard GPS vehicle tracking system on .NET Framework Web API, ADO.NET and T-SQL, plus ASP.NET MVC and Web Forms modules.

## Skills
C#, T-SQL, TypeScript, ASP.NET Core, .NET 8, Entity Framework Core, Blazor, SignalR, Angular, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Microsoft Azure, Docker, GitHub Actions, CQRS, Claude Code.

- Microsoft Certified Professional (MCP): passed Exam 70-486, Developing ASP.NET MVC Web Applications, score 933, November 2020. Verify: https://www.credly.com/badges/5edb0686-f2eb-4737-a95d-3039670edd7a
- Full Stack ASP.NET Core (96 hours), PencilBox Training Institute, 2022.
